```yaml
name: Standards & Trust - Tier 1

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0' # Weekly at midnight UTC

jobs:
  npm-provenance:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install
      
      - name: Publish with provenance
        run: npx changeset publish --provenance
        env:
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

  npm-trusted-publishers:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'
      
      - name: Configure OIDC linking
        run: echo "::add-mask::NPM_TOKEN"
        env:
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

  security-md:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Create SECURITY.md
        run: |
          echo "# Security\n\n## Disclosure Instructions\n\nPlease disclose vulnerabilities through our private vulnerability reporting tool." > SECURITY.md
      
      - name: Enable Private Vulnerability Reporting
        run: gh repo edit --private-vulnerability-reporting true

  readme-badges:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Add shields.io badges
        run: |
          echo "[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@pare/package.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pare/package)" >> README.md
          echo "[![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/@pare/package.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pare/package)" >> README.md
          echo "[![CI Status](https://github.com/Dave-London/Pare/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Dave-London/Pare/actions/workflows/ci.yml)" >> README.md
          echo "[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)" >> README.md
          echo "[![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/typescript-%3E%3D4.0-blue.svg)](https://www.typescriptlang.org/)" >> README.md
          echo "[![Node.js Version](https://img.shields.io/node/v/@pare/package.svg)](https://nodejs.org/)" >> README.md
          echo "[![Coverage](https://img.shields.io/codecov/c/github/Dave-London/Pare/main.svg)](https://codecov.io/gh/Dave-London/Pare)"

  npm-2fa-enforcement:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Enable 2FA enforcement
        run: npm config set //registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }} --global
        env:
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

  github-community-standards:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Ensure community standards are met
        run: |
          git checkout main
          git pull origin main
          git checkout -b update-community-standards
          touch README.md CODE_OF_CONDUCT CONTRIBUTING LICENSE ISSUE_TEMPLATE/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md SECURITY.md
          git add README.md CODE_OF_CONDUCT CONTRIBUTING LICENSE ISSUE_TEMPLATE/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md SECURITY.md
          git commit -m "Update community standards"
          git push origin update-community-standards
          gh pr create --title "Update community standards" --body "This PR updates the community standards as per the latest guidelines."

  spdx-license-verification:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Verify SPDX license
        run: |
          find . -name "package.json" | xargs grep '"license": "MIT"'
          if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "Error: Not all package.json files have the correct license."
            exit 1
          fi

  openssf-scorecard:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Run OpenSSF Scorecard
        run: curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ossf/scorecard/master/cmd/scorecard/scorecard | bash -s -- -l github.com/Dave-London/Pare
```
